context_requirements: Cells must be actively transcribing RNA polymerase I, II, and/or III for the inhibitor to have a target.
Rapidly proliferating cells with high ribosomal RNA and mRNA synthesis are more sensitive.
Intact stress and apoptotic signaling (e.g., TP53 for DNA damage and apoptosis components) shapes the secondary response.
Uptake or intracellular activation may be required depending on the specific inhibitor.
falsifiers: No decrease in proliferation or cell-cycle genes at 24 h across all nine lines.
No induction of immediate-early or stress genes at 6 h.
No reduction in RNA polymerase subunit or ribosome biogenesis transcripts.
A response indistinguishable from vehicle in all lines.
Selective strong response in only one line without a plausible context explanation.
